exit code was zero, but V2 accepted zero and rejected both checks under wrong rule ID; corrected rerun accepted one exact SourceRef and rejected the cross-case source.
SDK getToolDefinition(bash) raw inactive definition executed harmless printf without invoking actual Main permission wrapper; not evidence of authorization bypass.
The final feature-tour slide exposes a different Continue label; the generic Continue selector had no target. Corrected by using the visible skip control; no import or migration action was taken.

captureLimitations.detail: The r07 SDK capture was copied privately. Later r09/r10b in-process capture summaries were inspected but their session JSON was overwritten by the next Electron restart before archival. Their Main/V2 outcomes remain in retained runner stdout logs and persisted V2 records; no provider receipt is claimed.

Interactive follow-up results were not persisted by the original command runner; retained only as a sanitized structured outcome receipt with SHA-256. Electron Main stdout was discarded to prevent persistence of account-profile fields.

safetyNotes: No merge, P07 or P08 work was done.

One explicitly authorized campus account was used only for the authentication/UI gate; password remember was disabled, no account values were published, Main logout removed the account file and auth partition, and the isolated profile was destroyed.
No campus materials or hidden Gold were opened; review V1/V2 lists were empty and no case, run, assignment, turn or SourceRef was created.
